description: Confusion matrices on test at risk thresholds fixed on 2022
population: CRSS police-reported crashes (all severities, national probability sample) with a determinable maximum severity (fatal: MAXSEV_IM 9 excluded; ka: MAXSEV_IM 5 and 9 excluded, so ka rows are a subset); train 2016-2021, validation 2022, test 2023-2024
method: Thresholds from weighted 2022 predictions; test counts weighted (per year) and unweighted; Weighted (WEIGHT) and unweighted metrics; 95% percentile CIs from 200 Rao-Wu rescaled bootstrap replicates of PSU_VAR within PSUSTRAT (seed config.RANDOM_SEED); fatal metrics use every crash with a known fatal outcome; ka metrics use only the crashes where ka is known (MAXSEV_IM 5 and 9 excluded), so the two outcomes differ in n
